title: Jaxson Dart's injury a gut punch to Giants and John Harbaugh's potential storybook season

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Jaxson Dart's injury a gut punch to Giants and John Harbaugh's potential storybook season
sources.description: There was optimism around Jaxson Dart as the Giants left Los Angeles. There was none come Tuesday, with reports that New York's QB sustained a much more serious knee injury than first thought.
